questions.prompt: Explain why the mean calculated from grouped data is only an estimate.
questions.modelAnswer: In grouped data we don’t know the exact values in each class, only how many there are. We assume every value in a class equals its class mark (midpoint). The real values may be spread unevenly within the class, so the mean found this way is an estimate, not the exact mean.
